title: Wall Mount 2-Roll Reserve Toilet Paper Holder 8.5-Inch Solid Brass | Allied Brass
description:
Keep an extra roll ready with this space-saving wall-mounted 2-roll toilet paper holder. Crafted from high-quality solid brass, the Que New Collection vertical reserve holder combines transitional design with practical functionality. Its space-efficient design ensures you never run out of tissue while adding a sophisticated touch to your bath decor with dramatic circular detailing.

Highlights:
- Holds two rolls of toilet paper for a convenient reserve
- Crafted from solid brass for enduring quality and durability
- Concealed screw mounting provides a clean, seamless look
- Transitional style with sophisticated circular accents
- Available in 28 designer finishes to match any bathroom aesthetic

Specifications:
- Material: Solid Brass
- Dimensions: 6.4-in L x 8.5-in H x 3-in W
- Mounting Type: Wall Mounted
- Included: All installation hardware (#8 x 1 1/4" screws)
- Warranty: Limited Lifetime Warranty
